## Change

Explain the public reader's question or problem and what this change improves.

## Evidence

List primary sources and relevant versions. For search changes, list example queries and expected pages.

## Validation

Record commands and runtime/tool versions. Identify which examples were source reviewed, syntax parsed, type-checked, or behavior tested. State manual-only checks and remaining limitations.

- [ ] Content and category/index checks pass.
- [ ] Reader tests and build pass.
- [ ] New or changed references were checked.
